title: RNA Extraction, cDNA Synthesis and Taqman qPCR
author: gurvir.virdi
materials: Cell pellets are snap-frozen using dry ice.
Up to 1 µg of RNA per sample is reverse-transcribed into cDNA using the High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit (ThermoFisherScientific).
qPCR is performed using TaqMan TM Gene Expression Assay (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the Maxwell® RSC simply RNACells kit (Promega) and the Maxwell® RSC 48 instrument according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Measure and assess the concentration and quality of the extracted RNA using a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Perform TaqMan qPCR
steps.instruction: Conduct qPCR for each gene using TaqMan™ probes, TaqMan™ master mix, and sample cDNA, following the manufacturer's protocol.

substeps.instruction: Include a minus reverse transcriptase control (-RT) for each gene.
Run the samples on the QuantSudio 6 Flex Real-Time PCR System (Applied Biosystems).

steps.title: Analyze Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Normalize gene expression levels to the housekeeping gene GAPDH using the delta-delta Ct method, expressing values relative to their respective control samples.
